hook: *₹13,600 crore* Metro takeover loan stuck; Railway Minister 'not aware'
hook_b: *₹13,600 crore* Metro takeover loan stuck; Railway Minister 'not aware'
tldr: Railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said Metro Phase II isn't under his purview and he isn't aware of the IRFC loan Telangana needs to take over Phase I from L&T.

beats.what: IRFC signed an agreement in May but has not released about ₹13,600 crore, state officials say.
beats.why: The state needs the loan to complete the Phase I takeover from L&T; the Centre wants that done before Phase II.
beats.care: Phase II, estimated at ₹38,595 crore for 122 km of new corridors, still awaits Centre's DPR approval and funding.

causes.label: IRFC loan not released since May

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The state has started approaching other lenders, including Japanese ones for lower interest, and may take a lender switch to the cabinet.

cards.q: Which matters more to you right now?

qs: Who runs Metro day to day once the state takes over?
Would a new lender change the takeover timeline?

facts.t: Phase II plans *122 km* of new corridors at ₹38,595 crore.

steps.e: Vaishnaw says not aware of loan

viz.verdict: Phase II needs nearly 3x the stuck takeover loan

learn.t: IRFC = Indian Railway Finance Corporation, a government lender for rail projects

watch: Whether the cabinet approves switching to another lender before the December handover deadline.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Hyderabad Metro Phase-II not under my purview, not aware of ₹13.6K crore IRFC loan, says Ashwini Vaishnaw

fact: Telangana still waits for a *₹13,600 crore* loan to take over Metro
twist: L&T already pushed the Phase I handover deadline from May 1 to December.
